title: SymPhase: Phase Symbolization for Fast Simulation of Stabilizer Circuits
problem: Stabilizer circuit simulation requires multiple circuit traversals to compute measurement outcomes, creating a performance bottleneck for sampling-based analysis. Efficiently tracking accumulated Pauli faults through symbolic expressions remains challenging.
motivation: Efficient stabilizer circuit simulation enables faster generation of large sample sets for quantum error correction analysis and quantum computing research.
method: Phase symbolization represents Pauli faults as symbolic expressions within stabilizer generator phases. These symbolic phases are maintained in the stabilizer tableau using bit-vector encoding. A new memory data layout improves tableau access patterns. Measurement outcomes are computed as symbolic expressions and sampled by substituting variables with concrete values in a single forward pass.
key_novelty: Encoding measurement outcomes as symbolic expressions to eliminate repeated circuit traversals.
contributions: Phase symbolization technique for representing faults as symbolic expressions in stabilizer generators
Bit-vector encoding scheme for efficient symbolic phase maintenance in stabilizer tableau
Novel stabilizer tableau memory layout improving performance across simulation algorithms
SymPhase.jl implementation showing superior sampling time performance over Stim

metrics.speedup: Superior sampling time performance compared to Stim

primary_theme: Efficient quantum stabilizer circuit simulation via phase symbolization
